relevance_rank_note: Isogenic ApoE3/3 vs ApoE4/4 human iPSC brain endothelial cells with a direct transferrin pulse-chase recycling assay: recycling and internalization rates unchanged by ApoE4 (against), while endosomes enlarge, de-acidify and form fewer sorting tubules and TfR1 rises.

description: Pulse-chase of fluorescent transferrin showed that the rate at which internalized transferrin was recycled out of cells was similar in ApoE4 and ApoE3 iPSC brain endothelial cells in both isogenic pairs. No statistical test is reported; "similar" is the authors' word.
quote: Similarly, the total amount of Tf after a 20-min pulse was higher in ApoE4 compared to ApoE3 iCE-BECs (Figure 6B), but the recycling rate was similar between the two genetic variants (Figure 6D).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in transferrin/TfR1 recycling rate)
system: Human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic pairs: Bioni037-A ApoE3/3 vs Bioni037-A4 ApoE4/4, and Alstem iPS26 ApoE3/3 vs iPS16 ApoE4/4; 20 min fluorescent Tf pulse then chase up to 60 min, total vesicular Tf intensity normalized to t=0, exponential fit. In vitro.
human_check: No statistical test reported for rate comparison; 'similar' is the authors' wording. n = 6 differentiations (pair 1) and 3 (pair 2), 50 images per experiment. Endothelial cells, not astrocytes.

description: Continuous transferrin uptake curves normalized to each genotype's own 10-min value showed a similar internalization rate in ApoE4 and ApoE3 iPSC brain endothelial cells. No statistical test is reported.
quote: However, the rate of Tf internalization was similar between ApoE4 and ApoE3 iCE-BECs (Figure 6C).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in transferrin internalization rate)
system: Human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic ApoE3/3 vs ApoE4/4 pairs (Bioni037-A/A4, Alstem iPS26/iPS16); continuous fluorescent Tf uptake 1-20 min, vesicular intensity normalized to 10 min per condition. In vitro.
human_check: No test reported. n = 4 differentiations (pair 1) and 3 (pair 2).

description: Live imaging of transferrin-containing endosomes after 3 h Tf loading showed substantially fewer endosomal sorting tubules (the recycling carriers that bud from sorting endosomes) in ApoE4 than ApoE3 brain endothelial cells.
quote: In contrast, the number of sorting tubules was substantially reduced in ApoE4 iCE-BECs (Figure 5H).
system: Human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), isogenic pair 1 only (Bioni037-A ApoE3/3 vs Bioni037-A4 ApoE4/4); 25 ug/mL Tf-Alexa488 for 3 h, 1-min widefield videos at 100x, tubules per 1000 um2 per minute. In vitro.
human_check: Effect read off box medians (~0.32 vs ~0.14). n = 3 differentiations with 20 videos each; one isogenic pair only. Conflicts with the unchanged recycling rate in Fig 6D.

description: Ratio of pH-sensitive to pH-insensitive transferrin per endosome was lower in ApoE4 brain endothelial cells, indicating less acidic (higher pH) endosomes, the opposite direction to the hyperacidification reported in ApoE4 astrocytes. Effect detail: ~-11% (pair 1) to ~-20% (pair 2).
quote: This result points to a higher uptake of Tf and to a higher endosomal pH (i.e., less acidic) in ApoE4 iCE-BECs.
system: Human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic ApoE3/3 vs ApoE4/4 pairs; live cells loaded 10 min with 25 ug/mL Tf-pHrodo Red plus 25 ug/mL Tf-Alexa647, ratio per endosome. In vitro.
human_check: p is the two-way ANOVA main effect of genotype. Direction (alkalinized) is opposite to the NHE6/hyperacidification mechanism; decide whether that counts as against for the pH arm of H2.

description: Immunostaining showed higher EEA1 intensity per endosome and more EEA1-positive endosomes in ApoE4 vs ApoE3 brain endothelial cells, with enlarged endosomes confirmed by electron microscopy (EEA1 intensity per endosome: Fig 5B, p<0.001; endosome number: Fig 5C, p<0.01).
quote: We found that the number of early endosomes (labeled by EEA1) was higher in ApoE4 compared to ApoE3 iCE-BECs (Figures 5A and 5C). In addition, the total amount of EEA1 per endosome was also higher in ApoE4 compared to ApoE3 iCE-BECs (Figure 5B).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more and larger EEA1 early endosomes)
system: Human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic ApoE3/3 vs ApoE4/4 pairs; EEA1 immunostaining, mean vesicular integral intensity normalized to phalloidin area and to ApoE3, ~200 cells per condition. In vitro.
human_check: Effect read off box medians (~1.2-1.3 vs 1.0). Endosome number (Fig 5C) main effect p<0.01.

description: ApoE4 brain endothelial cells internalized about 50% more transferrin than ApoE3 cells in continuous uptake, attributed by the authors to higher TfR1 expression rather than altered trafficking. No P value is reported.
quote: ApoE4 iCE-BECs had a 50% higher total amount of internalized Tf compared to ApoE3 iCE-BECs (Figure 6A).
system: Human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic ApoE3/3 vs ApoE4/4 pairs; continuous fluorescent Tf uptake 1-20 min, vesicular intensity normalized to ApoE3 at 20 min; confirmed by flow cytometry (Fig S5C). In vitro.
human_check: Marked against because more ligand uptake implies receptor is not depleted from the surface; it is not a direct surface measurement. No p reported. Opposite direction to astrocyte Tf uptake (PMID 42239208).

description: TfR1 immunofluorescence integrated intensity was higher in ApoE4 than ApoE3 brain endothelial cells in both isogenic pairs.
quote: Significant main effect of genetic variant on TfR1 intensity, ∗∗∗p < 0.001; no significant main effect of iPSC line on TfR1 intensity
system: Human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic ApoE3/3 vs ApoE4/4 pairs; TfR1 immunostaining integrated intensity in phalloidin-positive area, ~200 cells per experiment, normalized to ApoE3. In vitro.
human_check: Effect read off box medians (~1.15-1.2 vs 1.0). Not stated whether staining was permeabilized, so treated as total TfR1. Western blot (Fig 6H) did not confirm; see next row.

description: TfR1 protein measured by immunoblot was not different between ApoE4 and ApoE3 brain endothelial cells in either isogenic pair. The legend says the genotype effect is not significant but gives no P. Effect detail: ~-1% (pair 1), ~+3% (pair 2).
quote: No significant main effect of genetic variant or iPSC line on TfR1 expression and no significant interaction between iPSC line and genetic variant by two-Way ANOVA with n = 3 independent differentiations.
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in total TfR1 protein)
system: Human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic ApoE3/3 vs ApoE4/4 pairs; whole-cell TfR1 immunoblot normalized to GAPDH. In vitro.
human_check: Legend says genotype effect not significant but gives no p value. Total receptor null, not a surface measurement.
